careers.applyHint: Applications go to the discipline lead, not to a recruitment inbox.

contact.title: Tell us what has stalled
contact.description: Tell us what has stalled and when it has to be resolved. We reply within two working days, from the engineer who would lead the work.
contact.name: Name
contact.message: What has stalled, and by when does it need resolving
contact.messageHint: A few sentences is enough. We will ask for drawings if we need them.
contact.emailHint: We reply from a named engineer, not a shared inbox.
contact.consent: I have read the privacy policy and agree to be contacted in reply.
contact.successBody: We will reply within two working days, from the engineer who would lead the work. If it is urgent before then, call {phone}.
contact.failureBody: Something went wrong at our end, not yours. Try again in a moment, or email {email} directly and your message will reach the same place.

errors.nameRequired: Enter your name, so we know who we are replying to.
errors.emailRequired: Enter an email address so we can reply.
errors.emailInvalid: That address is missing an @ or a domain. Check it and try again.
errors.enquiryRequired: Choose the closest discipline, so your enquiry reaches the right engineer.
errors.messageRequired: Tell us roughly what the project is, so we can route this to the right discipline.
errors.messageTooShort: A sentence or two more would help us route this correctly.
errors.consentRequired: We need your agreement before we can store your message and reply to it.
errors.tooFast: That was submitted faster than a person can type. If you are not a bot, wait a moment and send it again.

cookies.heading: Cookies on this site
cookies.body: We store one cookie to remember this choice. Analytics and preference cookies are not loaded unless you accept them, and nothing here is used for advertising.
cookies.necessaryDescription: Remembers this choice. Cannot be switched off, because the choice itself has to be stored.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Aggregated page measurement. The script is never requested if you decline.
cookies.preferencesDescription: Remembers interface choices, such as the language you last read the site in.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have been moved when the site was restructured. The links below cover everything on the site.

error.title: This page did not load
error.body: Something failed at our end. Reloading usually fixes it. If it does not, the rest of the site is unaffected and the contact page still works.
